features: Leaderboard adds Bachata Rising, Bachata Open and Bachata Invitational special-category filters
Special-category leaderboard rankings are calculated from published Final results rather than normal BDC progression point buckets
Bachata Rising and Bachata Open leaderboard points are fixed at 5-4-3-2-1 for 1st through 5th
Bachata Invitational leaderboard points are fixed at 3-2-1 for 1st through 3rd
Leader and Follower special-category rankings remain separate
Novice, Intermediate and Advanced progression leaderboard logic remains unchanged
